## 💎 Pull Request Template

### 📝 Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the changes you've made. Explain the "why" and "how" of your implementation.

### 🧩 Type of Change
Select the appropriate type for your PR:
- [ ] 🚀 Feature (New functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix (Non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🏗️ Refactor (Code improvement without behavioral changes)
- [ ] 🧪 Test (Adding or improving tests)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation (Changes to README, TODO, or Javadocs)

### ✅ Checklist
Before submitting, please ensure your PR meets the following:
- [ ] I have read and followed the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding style and naming conventions.
- [ ] I have added/updated unit tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All tests passed successfully using the quality-check script.
- [ ] My PR includes the required license headers in any new files.

### 🧪 How It Was Tested
Describe the testing process you followed to verify your changes.
- Environment: (e.g., Local Paper 1.20.1 server)
- Steps taken: (e.g., Spawned a treasure and verified that...)

### 📸 Screenshots (Optional)
If your change includes visual elements (holograms, custom items, UI changes), please include screenshots or GIFs here.

---
Thank you for your contribution! 🚀
